_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: score inside 63-70, neutral funding, grind momentum — no confirmed breaker to leave Hope yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Hope phase; analyst explicit HOLD, narrative silent on direction (low-info) so forward call follows analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score holds 63-70, funding stays near neutral, BTC grinds without fear/greed or 30d momentum breakout
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding/momentum heat toward analog and score clears 71 into Optimism, or long-liquidation flush drops fear/greed under 55 into Disbelief
